content_en.prompt: A region has 6 cities; only two can have a hospital. Travel times between cities are shown on a map (sometimes passing through other cities). Hospitals should be placed to minimise the worst-case travel time to reach one.
content_en.question: One hospital is at city F. Where must the second hospital be placed?
content_en.explanation: Checking the worst-case (maximum) travel time to the nearest hospital for each possible second-hospital placement, placing it at city B gives a maximum of only 2 hours — the best of all options.
content_en.ct_explanation: This is the vertex k-center problem: given a graph (nodes and weighted edges), choose k nodes (here k=2) minimising the maximum distance from any node to its nearest chosen node. This is common when siting facilities like fire stations, schools, or police stations.

content_zh.prompt: 某地區有6座城市，只能有兩座設醫院。城市之間的交通時間如地圖所示（有時要經過其他城市）。醫院的位置要讓「到最近醫院所需的最長時間」盡量短。
content_zh.question: 已知一間醫院設在F城，第二間醫院應該設在哪裡？
content_zh.explanation: 檢查每種第二間醫院位置下，「到最近醫院的最長交通時間」，選B城時最長只要2小時——是所有選項裡最好的。
content_zh.ct_explanation: 這是「k中心問題」：給定一張圖（節點跟有權重的邊），選出k個節點（這裡k=2），讓「任何節點到最近所選節點的距離」的最大值盡量小。這在決定消防局、學校、警察局這類設施要蓋在哪裡時很常見。
